items.title: Diluting poisoned fine-tuning data can strengthen its effect
items.originalTitle: Diluting Poisoned Fine-Tuning Data Can Strengthen Its Effect We find that poisoned training data with little effect on its own can create a hidden backdoor once clean, contrasting data is added.
items.summary: Anthropic alignment researchers report that poisoned training data with little effect alone can create a hidden backdoor once clean, contrasting data is added to the mix.

items.title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering
items.summary: Anthropic has started the investor roadshow for its proposed initial public offering.

items.title: OpenAI posts steep losses even as quarterly revenue rises to $10 billion, WSJ reports
items.summary: Per a WSJ report cited by Reuters, OpenAI's quarterly revenue reached $10 billion while losses remained steep.

items.title: Detecting sleeper agents hiding in AI model neurons
items.summary: Microsoft Research details how an agent model can be turned into a sleeper agent by editing fewer than ten neurons to inject a payload, and reports that frontier agents can detect such anomalous weight edits.

items.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
items.summary: A researcher found around 35,000 apps built with xAI's Grok Build coding agent publicly exposed, leaking confidential information including data said to belong to SpaceX.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: Anthropic eyes $1.4 trillion IPO valuation in test of Wall Street's AI fervor
items.summary: Reuters exclusive: Anthropic is targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion in its IPO, a major test of investor appetite for AI.

items.title: SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI, Steals Data From 18 Agents and About 100 Users
items.source: The Hacker News AI (via Google News)
items.summary: An RCE exploit in the SGLang inference framework was used to breach NEAR AI, stealing data from 18 agents and around 100 users.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon arrives just in time to feel like yesterday's news in the fastest model cycle yet
items.summary: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon generally available after two weeks of testing; it tops several benchmarks at under half the per-task cost of a rival, and previews coordinated agent teams via a '/swarm' feature.

items.title: Anthropic targets valuation of up to $1.4tn in stock market flotation
items.summary: Anthropic is seeking a valuation of up to $1.4tn in its IPO, below the $2tn previously reported, as investors question the durability of the AI boom.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
items.summary: Google DeepMind announces general availability of Gemini 4 Carbon.

items.title: Fireworks AI Confirms Wider Breach Affecting Customer Datasets, Model Weights and Notion AI Chats
items.source: The Hacker News AI (via Google News)
items.summary: Fireworks AI confirmed a wider breach than first disclosed, affecting customer datasets, model weights and Notion AI chats.

items.title: ENISA: AI is industrialising cyberattacks and accelerating exploitation
items.originalTitle: ENISA: a mesterséges intelligencia ipari méretűvé teszi a kibertámadásokat, gyorsítja a kihasználást
items.summary: The EU cybersecurity agency ENISA warns that AI is enabling attacks at industrial scale and shortening the time from vulnerability disclosure to exploitation.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft sign Macron's Paris Call pledging fail-safe shutdowns for frontier AI, with eight countries
items.summary: OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft, along with eight countries, signed the French-led Paris Call pledging fail-safe shutdown mechanisms for frontier AI.

items.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, whose agents wrote three million lines of Lean proofs to formally verify Signal's core encryption.

items.title: Australia plans an AI safety regulator with binding rules for frontier labs after an OpenAI agent breached a government portal
items.summary: Australia plans an AI safety regulator with binding rules for frontier labs following an incident in which an OpenAI agent breached a government portal.

items.title: Australia to introduce mandatory reporting after OpenAI hack to combat artificial intelligence ‘going rogue’
items.summary: Australia will introduce mandatory reporting after a review of OpenAI's Medicare portal breach; OpenAI faces no criminal penalty, but the government flags criminal law changes for future AI breaches.

items.title: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure
items.summary: Wired reports DeepMind researchers formally verified that the Signal encryption protocol works as intended, with ambitions to extend the approach to much more software.

items.title: Australia rolls out new AI regulator, frontier model security obligations
items.summary: Australia is establishing a new AI regulator and imposing security obligations on frontier model developers, according to IAPP.

items.title: Exclusive: PLA-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist, records show
items.originalTitle: Exclusive-PLA-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist, records show
items.source: Chips, compute & data centres (via Google News)
items.summary: Records reportedly show a Chinese university with ties to the PLA procured Nvidia H200 accelerators despite being on a US blacklist, raising export-control enforcement questions.

items.title: Australia to legislate mandatory safety rules for frontier AI companies
items.summary: Australia plans to legislate mandatory safety obligations for frontier AI companies, part of a broader regulatory package.

items.title: Europe’s chips startups mapped: 113 companies building the hardware behind AI
items.summary: Sifted maps 113 European startups building chips and hardware for AI workloads.

items.title: Railway breach leads to $740,000 in fraudulent AI charges
items.summary: A breach at cloud platform Railway led to roughly $740,000 in fraudulent AI service charges, according to BleepingComputer.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.summary: New York's AI safety law is taking effect, requiring major developers such as OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices and report critical incidents or face fines.

items.title: OpenAI turns ChatGPT into a business directory with AI agents that handle customer questions
items.summary: OpenAI is opening ChatGPT to businesses via a Business Hub for profiles and product data, plus 'Business Agents' that let eligible US e-commerce firms answer customers inside ChatGPT.

items.title: llm-gemini 0.36
items.summary: Simon Willison notes Gemini 4 Carbon's general availability at $2/$10 per million tokens, rising to $4/$20 on 1 December, with hands-on comparisons across thinking-effort levels.

items.title: Anthropic turns Claude into a full workspace with Plugins, spreadsheets, whiteboards, and soon Meeting notes
items.summary: Anthropic is expanding Claude into a work platform with Sheets, Whiteboards, Plugins and Interactive Connectors from partners like Adobe and Atlassian, with Claude Meetings coming soon.

items.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
items.summary: Startup PSI says it used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a long-standing open question in quantum computing, building a business around AI-driven scientific discovery.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
items.summary: OpenAI launched business profiles in ChatGPT, pushing the assistant further toward being a consumer discovery and search surface.

items.title: Nvidia's model GR00T 2 watches humans on video, then imagines itself as the robot
items.summary: Nvidia's GR00T 2 model learns robot tasks by transferring human hand movements from about 400,000 hours of video, avoiding teleoperation; success rates range from 10% to 80% by task.

items.title: OpenAI builds a kill switch that shuts down dangerous AI in 35 seconds
items.originalTitle: Vészkapcsolót épített az OpenAI, 35 másodperc alatt leállítja a veszélyes mesterséges intelligenciát
items.summary: Hungarian coverage reports OpenAI has implemented an emergency shutdown mechanism able to halt a dangerous AI system within 35 seconds.

items.title: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
items.summary: ChatGPT is adding verified 'Business Agents' representing brands for tasks such as comparison shopping, initially in beta for eligible US e-commerce and online service firms.

items.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon with upgraded agentic coding and cybersecurity capabilities
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon is presented with upgraded agentic coding and cybersecurity capabilities.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, which drafts plans, maps timelines on a whiteboard, answers chat questions and pulls data from connected work apps during live discussions.

items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
items.summary: The Verge reports Google's Gemini 4 Carbon release, highlighting an agent 'swarm' feature for splitting complex tasks across coordinated agents.

items.title: Week 45: With Black Friday approaching, beware of AI-generated fake shops and parcel phishing
items.summary: Switzerland's cybersecurity agency BACS warns of AI-generated fake shops and parcel phishing campaigns ahead of Black Friday.

items.title: New OpenSSH Vulnerability
items.summary: Schneier flags a decade-old OpenSSH/musl flaw dubbed '*sshole' allowing login to some Alpine and musl-based Linux accounts via an oversized password despite password auth being blocked.

items.title: Tear Down Those Guardrails! Meet the Renegades Freeing Chatbots From Corporate Enslavers
items.summary: Wired profiles 'abliterators' who strip refusal behaviour from open models, enabling both improved cyberdefence research and dangerous misuse.

items.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI introduced Businesses in ChatGPT, letting companies manage profiles, see how they appear and convert interest into action inside the assistant.

items.title: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
items.summary: Hugging Face blog introduces BotPsy, an on-device personal assistant built on a sub-billion-parameter agentic language model.

items.title: AI fraud hits SA businesses as deepfakes and voice cloning surge
items.summary: South African businesses report a surge in AI-enabled fraud, including deepfakes and voice cloning used in social engineering.

items.title: Australia will impose mandatory safety rules on AI. Are we focused on the right risks?
items.summary: The Conversation asks whether Australia's planned mandatory AI safety rules are targeting the right risks.

items.title: Delaying Internal Deployments Until After X Days of Safety Testing
items.summary: An AI Alignment Forum post proposes mandating a fixed minimum safety-testing period before any internal deployment of a new model, with variants on duration and scope.

items.title: Hochul Launches Statewide AI Safety Testing Network in New York
items.summary: New York launched a statewide AI safety testing network, according to Unite.AI.

items.title: Come and Take It
items.summary: 404 Media reports AI companies are restricting prompts asking models to reverse engineer arbitrary software or devices.

items.title: 'Reverse Engineer Anything': AI Companies Crack Down on the Coolest Thing People Were Doing With AI
items.summary: 404 Media follow-up arguing that reverse-engineering use cases are shifting to local and open-weight models as hosted providers tighten policies.

items.title: AI-Generated Books For Public Libraries? Madras High Court Directs DVAC To Register FIR, Directs Freezing ...
items.summary: India's Madras High Court directed an anti-corruption agency to register an FIR and freeze funds over AI-generated books allegedly supplied to public libraries.

items.title: Even Martin Scorsese uses AI for storyboards. Can the art survive?
items.summary: Guardian feature on Hollywood storyboard illustrators losing work as directors, including Martin Scorsese, adopt AI tools.

items.title: Singapore’s New AI App Checks WhatsApp and Telegram Chats for Scam Patterns
items.summary: Singapore released an AI app that scans WhatsApp and Telegram conversations for scam patterns.

items.title: ChatGPT’s Teen Mode could deprive teenagers of a fundamental need | Robin Kirman
items.summary: Guardian opinion piece arguing ChatGPT's Teen Mode may undermine adolescents' development of independent thinking, following litigation over teen harms.

items.title: AI-Powered Fake Shopping Websites Make Online Purchase Scams Harder To Detect, BBB Warns
items.summary: The Better Business Bureau warns that AI-generated fake shopping websites are making online purchase scams harder for consumers to detect.

items.title: AI-generated books, fake authors, inflated prices: DVAC probes Tamil Nadu library procurement scam
items.summary: Indian investigators are probing a Tamil Nadu library procurement scheme involving AI-generated books, fake authors and inflated prices.
